mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM Recipes r LEFT JOIN Categories c ON r.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY RAND()
SELECT r.*, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM Recipes r LEFT JOIN Categories c ON r.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY r.view DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT r.*, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM Recipes r JOIN Categories c ON r.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.recipes_id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM Recipes r JOIN Recipe_Ingredients ri ON r.recipes_id = ri.recipes_id JOIN Ingredients i ON ri.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
SELECT * FROM Recipes WHERE foodName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
SELECT i.* FROM Ingredients i JOIN Recipe_Ingredients ri ON i.ingredient_id = ri.ingredient_id WHERE ri.recipes_id = #{recipesId}
mapper.update: UPDATE Recipes SET view = #{view} WHERE recipes_id = #{recipesId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE users_id = #{userId} AND recipes_id = #{recipesId}
